title: Battle of Kobrin
text: The Battle of Kobrin, or the Battle of Kobryn, took place on 27 July 1812 between the Russian and Saxon forces – under the command of Alexander Tormasov and Jean Reynier respectively – in the city of Kobrin (Kobryn) at the initial stage of the French invasion of Russia. The battle was a clear victory of the Russian forces. The incompetence on the part of Reynier was that he underestimated Tormasov's strength and overstretched his troops, leaving his entire brigade vulnerable to encirclement, which the Russian commander took advantage of.
